notes.title: REDNECK BOWL GAMES
notes.notes: New levels 17 & 18 with countdown timer when the Bowling Frame is active.   Levels with the cans move more regularly.  The Frame number has its red color back.  Any ideas for new levels just leave them in discussion room or Veterangamesusa on Facebook.   I'll add them in the updates as needed.  Spiders have been added to some of the levels.   Practice levels are in the main menu now, and you don't have to go to another level to reach it.
